arguments.text: 6000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) watch the pod against GPS speed and heart rate for pod drift; if the pod drifts, set pod_gain so the pacer reads true effort. (2) watch local push within a leg for weed; clear_rudder if a clear drop. (3) handle radio messages (course length: set_race_distance + tell). (4) check whether pre-race critical power looks right from heart rate trend at steady effort. Baseline: share of pod power reaching boat ~0.62 at start. At ~6 min establish baseline ratio boat-power/pod-power and HR at steady effort, then set watches.

arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; drifts with pod gain, drag, or current misfit

arguments.description: heart rate per pod watt; jumps if the pod drifts
